page.overview:
Who is Jerome Ramped?

Jerome is one of the Lemons who attempt to chase down Finn McMissile, after they discover he is spying on them on the Oil Rig.

Jerome attempts to kill McMissile with a blowtorch (alongside Towga Gremlin & Stefan Gremsky), but the British agent drives backwards and jumps off a platform, shocking Jerome and the other Lemons.

Like all the other Lemons, Jerome Ramped was a cold-hearted terrorist who would do anything to become rich and powerful. He was also very sadistic for cornering Finn McMissle with a blow torch with all the other Lemons at the Oil Rig. Jerome was shocked when his target made risky moves to escape from him.
